triage.kind_span: SLRC and SUNS are proposing a combination of both companies by a merger and related transactions pursuant to the Merger Agreement

subject_names.value: SLR Investment Corp.; SLR Senior Investment Corp.
subject_names.span: SLR Investment Corp. 500 Park Avenue New York, New York 10022 (212) 993-1670 SLR Senior Investment Corp.

subject_tickers.span: SLRC Common Stock trades on The Nasdaq Global Select Market (Nasdaq) under the ticker symbol SLRC. SUNS Common Stock trades on the Nasdaq under the symbol SUNS.

security_class.span: each share of common stock, par value $0.01 per share, of SUNS (SUNS Common Stock) issued and outstanding immediately prior to the Effective Time

acquirer.span: with SUNS continuing as the surviving company and as a wholly owned subsidiary of SLR Investment Corp., a Maryland corporation (SLRC)

targets.span: the common stock of SLR Senior Investment Corp. (the securities to be cancelled in the mergers)

n_targets.span: SLRC and SUNS are proposing a combination of both companies by a merger

exchange_basis.span: The Exchange Ratio will be equal to the quotient (rounded to four decimal places) of (i) the SUNS Per Share NAV divided by (ii) the SLRC Per Share NAV.

collar.span: There will be no adjustment to the Merger Consideration for changes in the market price of shares of SLRC Common Stock.

spans: Closing of the Mergers is contingent upon (i) SLRC stockholder approval of the Merger Stock Issuance Proposal, (ii) SUNS stockholder approval of the Merger Proposal and (iii) satisfaction or waiver of certain other closing conditions.
it is a condition to the obligations of SUNS and of SLRC to consummate the Mergers that SUNS and SLRC will together obtain a legal opinion to that effect.

expected_close.span: SLRC and SUNS are working to complete the Mergers in the first half of 2022.

notes: Preliminary N-14 8C (dated December 15, 2021) for the two-step merger of SLR Senior Investment Corp. (SUNS) into SLR Investment Corp. (SLRC); both are BDCs. Exchange ratio is NAV-for-NAV, set at a Determination Date no earlier than 48 hours before the Effective Time; the 0.7763 SLRC shares per SUNS share figure is illustrative only (based on September 30, 2021 NAVs including estimated transaction costs), so exchange_ratio is null. Cash only in lieu of fractional shares, so cash_per_share is null. collar=false because the filing states no adjustment to the Merger Consideration for SLRC market-price changes. Meeting dates and record dates are placeholders ([●], 2022) in this preliminary filing: null. Termination/outside date is in 'Description of the Merger Agreement - Termination', which is after the excerpt cut: null. Conditions: the excerpt states stockholder approvals and the tax-opinion condition plus 'certain other closing conditions'; the full conditions section ('Description of the Merger Agreement - Conditions to Closing the Mergers') is after the cut, so other categories (e.g. registration_effective, regulatory_approval) may exist but are not stated here. The filing says the parties believe they have obtained all necessary third party consents (including HSR) other than stockholder approval; not recorded as a condition.
